content: inputOutputControlParameter idle state The inputOut- putControlParameter of data element of IOOperationRequest from S/R inter- face IOControlRequest_DID shall have an initial value of 0xFF. This value indicates the application, that the Dcm is currently not processing an UDS service to control this DID .
